howSpursPlayed: Spurs had 65.0% of the ball and 72.7% of the passing in the opposition half, against a season average of 60.9%.
They took 16 shots (5 on target) worth 0.86 xG, about 0.05 per shot; Coventry City had 12 shots worth 0.77 xG.

summary: Spurs lined up in a 3-1-4-2 against Coventry City's 4-2-3-1 (5 changes from the Man Utd game, switching from 4-2-3-1).
Chances were even (0.86 xG to 0.77), so the win came down to finishing and fine margins.
Compared with their other league games, Spurs conceded less (0.77 xG vs 1.29 xG), pressed harder (3.5 vs 4.4), got into the box less (24 vs 30), settled for lower-quality chances (0.05 vs 0.08).
Tonali was the biggest attacking threat (0.35 xG + xA).

phases.title: Build-up and possession

rows.label: Long balls, share of accurate passes

read: Spurs had 65% of the ball (season average 60%), completing 505 of 566 passes (89%).
73% of all passing in the opposition half was by Spurs (field tilt), above their usual 67%. They spent long spells camped in Coventry City's half.
45% of Spurs' accurate passes were in their own half (225 own half, 280 opposition half): most of the passing happened high up the pitch.
Long balls made up 2.2% of accurate passes (below the season's 3.8%), with 39% of long balls finding a teammate. Spurs built short and rarely went direct.

phases.title: Chance creation
read: 16 shots (5 on target) worth 0.86 xG, 0.05 per shot; the season average is 0.08 per shot, so the chances were lower quality than usual.
10 shots came from inside the box and 6 from outside (38% from distance).
Spurs created 0 big chances and missed 0 (season average 2.3).
24 touches in Coventry City's box, below the season average of 30; Coventry City had 26 in Spurs' box.
Where the xG came from: open play 0.68 (79%), fast breaks 0.09, set pieces 0.09. 9 of the shots came straight from a teammate's pass (assisted).
7 successful take-ons (39% success), season average 11.7.

phases.title: Finishing
read: Spurs scored 3 from 0.86 xG: 2.1 more than the chances were worth.
Shots on target were worth 1.32 xGOT against 0.86 xG before the shot: the finishing placed shots better than average.
Coventry City's goalkeeper made 2 saves.

phases.title: Out of possession
read: PPDA (estimated): 3.5 Coventry City passes in their own half per Spurs defensive action; season average 4.4. Lower means a more aggressive press, so this was a more intense press than usual.
13 tackles won and 6 interceptions (season averages 18.7 and 8.0); 30 clearances and 4 blocks.
Duels: Spurs won 58, Coventry City 59 (50% for Spurs); 55% of aerial duels won.
Coventry City managed 12 shots worth 0.77 xG (Spurs usually concede 1.29 xG) and 1 big chance.

phases.title: Transitions and set pieces
read: Fast breaks: Spurs had 1 shot on the break (0.09 xG); Coventry City had 3 (0.12 xG), against a season average of 1.1 shots conceded on the break.
With Spurs holding most of the ball, those breaks show the space left behind when the team pushed up.
Set pieces: 2 Spurs shots (0.09 xG, 0 goals); Coventry City 3 (0.08 xG, 0 goals). Corners: 4–4.

flow: First half: 0.43 xG for, 0.32 against (1–0). Second half: 0.42 for, 0.46 against (2–1).
Spells on top (momentum index): Spurs 12–26'; Spurs 31–37'; Spurs 52–67'.
